name: ActiTIME
description: actiTIME is time-tracking and work-management software for teams that need accurate timesheets, project visibility, billing data, leave records, and workforce administration. Organizations use it to organize customers, projects, and tasks, record and approve working time, manage people and leave, calculate labor costs, and report on delivery performance.
agentUseSummary: Add a dedicated actiTIME integration user's installation URL, username, and password, then choose which agents can read or manage the connected account's work, time, leave, people, rates, settings, and webhook subscriptions under Safe or Dangerous policy.

credentialRequirements.label: actiTIME installation URL
credentialRequirements.helpText: Enter the HTTPS address you use to open actiTIME. Relay limits requests to that installation's /api/v1 route.

credentialRequirements.label: actiTIME username
credentialRequirements.helpText: Use a dedicated actiTIME integration user with only the permissions your agents need.

credentialRequirements.label: actiTIME password
credentialRequirements.helpText: Enter that integration user's password. Relay encrypts it and sends it only to the configured actiTIME installation.

capabilities.label: Read time, work, people, and settings
capabilities.description: Use all 32 pinned reads for customers, projects, tasks, time, leave, users, departments, rates, settings, and webhook subscriptions.

capabilities.label: Manage time, work, people, and settings
capabilities.description: Use all 26 pinned mutations to create, update, lock, unlock, invite, replace, subscribe, batch, or delete authorized actiTIME records.

allowed.label: Read actiTIME
allowed.description: Run one exact selected read operation from the pinned public actiTIME REST API.

approvalRequired.label: Manage actiTIME
approvalRequired.description: Run one exact selected actiTIME mutation; Safe mode requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: All 32 bounded reads run directly; every mutation requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: All 58 selected and user-authorized operations run without Relay per-action approval; installation ownership, actiTIME permissions, exact routes, bounds, audits, redaction, plan limits, and credential non-exposure still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts all 58 pinned public actiTIME REST operations through the encrypted customer-credential connector.

evidence.supports: actiTIME's official API overview documents HTTPS Basic authentication with a customer's username and password, paid Online and Self-Hosted availability, v1 resources, permissions, errors, and rate limits.
actiTIME's official usage guide confirms installation-relative /api/v1 routes and Basic authorization rather than a distributable OAuth application.
actiTIME's official REST Hooks guide documents subscription list, create, unsubscribe, and delete operations and supported events.
